input.quote: 1.5 "FIELD OF USE" means, and is limited to, the utilization of the Licensed Technology by the Licensee for the exclusive purpose of fulfilling Spot FX transactions by transmitting market data and orders.
input.rationale: No covenant restricts the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The restrictive-covenant article (Art. X) contains only nondisclosure and a non-solicitation of Licensor employees (p0125) — no non-compete. The "Field of Use" definition (p0007) and the Article II additional restrictions (p0027, p0040-p0047) are internal license-scope limits on how we may use Licensor's Licensed Technology (Spot FX market data/order transmission, no sublicensing, no Derivative Works of the Licensed Technology); they do not bar us from operating competing lines, buying other platforms, or developing our own technology independently. Separately, the Change of Control provision (p0134) lets Licensor deem consent reasonably withheld where an acquirer competes with Licensor, but that is a termination/consent right rather than a restraint on our business activities, so it falls to the change-of-control/assignment rule rather than NONCOMPETE. Restrictions on Licensor (e.g., its non-exclusive retained rights) are not our concern. Preferred position — no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer's business — is met; no redline needed.
